desc.zh: 查明本地与联邦的权责争议：两份税单如何对账，提案以谁的名义起草，墨西哥城与海对岸的伙伴各自如何作答；每一步都记在答话国自己名下。
desc.en: Identify the local-federal responsibility dispute: how the two tax bills reconcile, in whose name the proposal is drafted, and how Mexico City and the overseas partners each answer; every step is recorded under the answering country's own name.

desc.zh: 守备出资与任命授权都要落在各自预算上：新明自筹民兵薪饷，墨西哥决定任命归属；任何一方的执行都用自己的钱，不授免费军队。
desc.en: Guard funding and appointment authority both land on real budgets: New Ming pays its own militia payroll, Mexico settles who appoints; each side executes with its own money and no free military grant is created.

title.en: The Review of the Federal Promise

desc.zh: 承诺落实要复核：码头地契与一季汇款照实对账，协定文本由两家议会分别确认，余波按实际实行记录；欠缴与缩约同样入册。
desc.en: Promises are audited: the wharf deeds and the missing quarter are reconciled as they actually stand, the pact text is confirmed by each congress separately, and the aftermath is recorded as practiced; defaults and shrinkage enter the same ledger.

title.zh: 同一户人家的两份税单
title.en: Two Tax Bills for One Household

desc.zh: 同一份海关册上新明记一笔汇缴，墨西哥城另记一笔防务摊派。提案的王廷要逐项核对本地与联邦各自的科目：谁征什么、谁承担什么，能承担的汇缴额在哪里。
desc.en: On the same customs ledger, New Ming enters one remittance and Mexico City another defense levy. The proposing court must reconcile line by line which duties belong to the locality and which to the federation, and what remittance the local budget can actually carry.
